Seedhe Jawab

Aapke Sawaal —
Honest Jawab

❌ "Ground pe kuch dikhta nahi — project real hai?"

Plotting mein construction risk nahi hota — aap zameen khareed rahe hain, flat nahi. Zameen kahin nahi jaati. Site plan, master plan, vendor contracts — sab ready hain. Personally site visit karein — zameen dekhein, road dekhein, Patanjali dekhein.

❌ "10 mahine mein milega — guarantee kya hai?"

Plotting delivery flat se alag hai. Koi construction dependency nahi. Boundary wall, internal roads, underground utilities — 10 mahine ka kaam. Registered plot aapke naam. Club aur mandir baad mein complete honge — tab tak aap ghar bana rahe honge.

❌ "Haridwar mein aur bhi projects hain — yeh special kya hai?"

Ek sawaal: Kisi aur project mein Giant Shankh hai? Chakra Mandal Garden hai? Om Mandir hai? 3-floor club with lift hai? Patanjali 0km pe hai? Ganga Expressway benefit hai? Agar haan — wahan jaiye. Agar nahi — jawab mil gaya.

❌ "Abhi nahi — baad mein dekhenge"

Jo pehle aayega — woh pura appreciation capture karega. NH award ke baad price badh jaayegi. Kumbh ke baad price badh jaayegi. "Baad mein" ka matlab — woh return jo aapka ho sakta tha, kisi aur ka ho gaya.
